channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: How students in Japan strive to escape the international school bubble
item.description: With a life spent outside the public school system, some students at international schools struggle to integrate into broader Japanese society.

item.title: Beyond fins, Japanese firms seeking new values in sharks
item.description: Their fins are prized in Chinese cuisine but many consumers do not know about other dining options.

item.title: Japan’s booming tourism industry struggling to improve sustainability
item.description: Emissions from the high-polluting tourism sector are hitting Japan's climate goals, but some destinations are finding their own climate solutions.

item.title: Tokyo’s Ginza marks 20 years of urban beekeeping
item.description: Designed to foster harmony between cities and nature, the project has many followers nationwide and is seen as a model for urban beekeeping.

item.title: Japan to lend Mongolia ¥150 billion for airport expansion
item.description: Passenger traffic at Ulaanbaatar's Chinggis Khaan International Airport has far exceeded expectations since it opened in 2021.

item.title: Japanese anime actor fights TikTok over AI voice cloning
item.description: AI imitation is a growing concern among performers worldwide, and the threat has roiled Japan's storied animation industry.

item.title: Japan Defense Ministry to support startups in UAV development
item.description: The three main research targets will be incorporating domestic components, increasing efficiency in supply warehouses and reducing aircraft noise.

item.title: Japan’s LDP worried about fresh attention to money issue
item.description: Behind the concerns are Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi's controversial appointments of two lawmakers involved in her LDP's slush fund scandal.

item.title: Shin Ohashi leads charge for Team Japan halfway through Asian Games
item.description: Ohashi led the Japanese delegation with five medals through the first seven days.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
